name: CHO Smoothed EA
summary: This EA trades based on the Chaikin Oscillator (CHO) with smoothing applied to reduce noise and generate cleaner signals. It enters long positions when the smoothed CHO crosses above its signal line or zero level, and enters short positions on the opposite condition. The EA includes configurable smoothing periods, lot sizing, and basic stop loss/take profit management.
summary_zh: 该EA基于经平滑处理的蔡金震荡指标(CHO)进行交易，通过平滑减少噪音产生更清晰的信号。当平滑CHO上穿信号线或零轴时做多，下穿时做空。EA包含可配置的平滑周期、手数设置及基本的止损止盈管理。
strategy_analysis: 策略概念基于蔡金震荡指标(CHO)的平滑版本，CHO通过累积/派发线计算资金流入流出，平滑处理减少了原始CHO的频繁假信号。入场条件为平滑CHO上穿零轴或信号线时开多单，下穿时开空单，利用动量方向确认趋势资金流向。出场条件依赖固定的止损止盈设定，部分版本可能在CHO反向交叉时平仓。仓位管理采用固定手数或基于资金比例的方式，缺乏自适应仓位调整。资金管理方面仅有基本的止损保护，没有浮亏保护或动态止损机制，整体风控较为基础。
strategy_analysis_en: The strategy concept is based on a smoothed version of the Chaikin Oscillator (CHO), which measures money flow accumulation and distribution, with smoothing applied to reduce frequent false signals from the raw CHO. Entry conditions trigger a long position when the smoothed CHO crosses above the zero line or signal line, and a short position on the opposite cross, confirming momentum direction aligned with money flow. Exit conditions rely on fixed stop loss and take profit settings, with some variants closing positions on reverse CHO crossovers. Position sizing uses either fixed lots or a simple balance-based percentage approach, lacking adaptive position sizing based on volatility or account equity changes. Money management is basic with only standard stop loss protection, lacking trailing stops, equity protection, or dynamic risk adjustment mechanisms, making the overall risk control relatively rudimentary.

parameters.description_en: CHO slow period (A/D line slow EMA period)

parameters.name: TakeProfit
parameters.description_en: Take profit in points per level

parameters.name: MagicNumber
parameters.description_en: EA magic number for order identification

pros: 蔡金震荡指标结合平滑处理有效减少假信号和频繁交易
基于资金流向的动量逻辑具有理论依据，CHO反映市场累积派发力量
参数可配置性强，交易者可根据不同品种和时间框架调整平滑周期
pros_en: Smoothed CHO effectively reduces false signals and over-trading compared to raw oscillator
The money flow momentum logic has solid theoretical basis, as CHO reflects real accumulation/distribution forces
Highly configurable parameters allow traders to adjust smoothing periods for different instruments and timeframes
cons: 单一指标策略缺乏多维度确认，震荡市中容易产生连续亏损
没有动态止损或移动止损机制，固定止损可能不适应市场波动变化
缺少新K线检查机制，可能在同一根K线上重复开仓导致过度交易
cons_en: Single-indicator strategy lacks multi-dimensional confirmation, prone to consecutive losses in ranging markets
No trailing stop or dynamic stop mechanism, fixed SL/TP may not adapt to changing market volatility
Lacks new bar check mechanism, potentially opening multiple positions on the same bar causing over-trading
improvements: 增加多时间框架确认或其他指标(如趋势过滤器)减少假信号
实现移动止损和基于ATR的动态止损止盈以适应市场波动
improvements_en: Add multi-timeframe confirmation or additional indicators (e.g., trend filter) to reduce false signals
Implement trailing stop and ATR-based dynamic stop loss/take profit to adapt to market volatility

risk_points: 缺少新K线检查可能在同一根K线上重复开仓
固定止损不适应所有市场波动环境，低波动时止损过大高波动时止损过小
risk_points_en: Lacks new bar check, potentially opening duplicate positions on the same bar
Fixed stop loss does not adapt to all volatility environments — too wide in low volatility, too tight in high volatility
